title: EEG-MedRAG: Enhancing EEG-based Clinical Decision-Making via Hierarchical Hypergraph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2508.13735v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With the widespread application of electroencephalography (EEG) in neuroscience and clinical practice, efficiently retrieving and semantically interpreting large-scale, multi-source, heterogeneous EEG data has become a pressing challenge. EEG-MedRAG addresses this challenge through a three-layer hypergraph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework that unifies EEG domain knowledge, individual patient cases, and large-scale EEG recordings into a traversable n-ary relational hypergraph, enabling joint semantic-temporal retrieval and evidence-grounded clinical reasoning. The accompanying benchmark is the first to pair EEG questions about the same clinical fact across five user roles. Its 700 questions span seven clinical domains and support direct comparisons of answer consistency across roles. translated_title: EEG-MedRAG：通过分层超图检索增强生成提升基于脑电图的临床决策
translated_abstract: 随着脑电图（EEG）在神经科学和临床实践中的广泛应用，如何高效检索并对大规模、多源、异构的脑电数据进行语义解读已成为一项紧迫的挑战。EEG-MedRAG通过一个基于三层超图的检索增强生成框架来应对这一挑战，该框架将脑电领域知识、个体患者病例以及大规模脑电记录统一为一个可遍历的n元关系超图，从而实现语义-时间联合检索与基于证据的临床推理。其配套的基准测试首次将针对同一临床事实的脑电问题在五种用户角色间进行配对，共包含700个问题，覆盖七个临床领域，支持对跨角色答案一致性的直接比较。在三种大语言模型骨干上，EEG-MedRAG在整体答案正确性和词元级F1分数上均优于全部四个基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出EEG-MedRAG，一个基于三层超图的检索增强生成框架，将脑电领域知识、患者病例和大规模脑电记录统一为n元关系超图以实现语义-时间联合检索与循证临床推理，并借助首个跨五种用户角色评估答案一致性的脑电基准测试，在多个大语言模型上超越全部基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EEG-MedRAG, a three-layer hypergraph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework that unifies EEG domain knowledge, patient cases, and large-scale EEG recordings into an n-ary relational hypergraph for joint semantic-temporal retrieval and evidence-grounded clinical reasoning, outperforming all baselines on the first benchmark assessing answer consistency across five user roles.
